name: Just show free stuff in Elementor
author: Michael

sections.description:
This plug-in will remove/hide pro features so the interface will be a bit cleaner.
Tested with Elementor 3.35.0.

Note: if you already use a child theme with an admin style I recommend looking at the plugin source and just add those to your admin CSS instead of adding the plugin!

It will clean up the following parts:
* remove the “upgrade” button from the main Elementor menu
* hides the upgrade features from the “home” feature list
* hides the Youtube iframe and banner image from the editor – quick settings page
* hides the upgrade button from the editor submenu
* hides all pro widgets in the Elementor Editor panel
* hides the promotion messages in the Elementor Editor
* hides the upgrade banner from the Hello menu

If you use Elementor Pro it will keep the Pro features visible.
